Hi Sara — sorry for the friction here and thanks for confirming Wed 14:00 GMT.

Workaround notes we use internally:
- Calendly: add the tz query param (Europe/London) or append &hide_landing_page_details=1 for some embeds.
- Chili Piper: handles browser locale more reliably but needs a different integration.
- Manual ICS: simplest for one-off slots if the customer's laptop blocks tz detection.

I'll attach an ICS for Wed 2026-03-17 14:00 GMT (I've set it to Europe/London). If that looks good, accept and it will show in your calendar correctly.

Attachment: demo-invite-london.ics (text/calendar)
